# Attach over CDP

The browser exposes a DevTools endpoint that a client can attach to without launching a new instance. The client connects over the WebSocket endpoint advertised by the browser process.

A tab is attached with a flat session so commands and events carry a session identifier.

https://blog.example.test/posts/cdp-sess.text:
# Attaching a browser session

A long lived browser session keeps cookies and logins available to the client that attaches to it. Reusing that session avoids a second sign in and keeps the profile warm.

Session identifiers change when the browser restarts.

# DevTools protocol overview

Browser targets describe tabs, pages and workers. A flat session multiplexes them over a single connection.

Events are delivered in the order the browser emitted them.
